solution_text:
1. Activate Pathmaker Initiate, making Kari Zev, Skyship Raider unblockable this turn.
2. Cast Consuming Fervor on Kari Zev, making her a 5/7.
3. Attack with Kari Zev, and her trigger puts Ragavan on the battlefield attacking alongside her.
4. Cast Djeru's Resolve, untapping Pathmaker Initiate, and activating its ability again, this time targeting Ragavan.
5. Neither attacker can be blocked. First strike damage resolves, and Kari Zev deals 5 damage to your opponent.
6. After this, cast Disperse, targeting Consuming Fervor, and then recast it on Ragavan, making the monkey into a 5/4. Normal damage resolves, and your opponent has taken a total of 10!
